name: Brooke
bio: Brooke has worked professionally with dogs for over 8 years and has owned dogs her whole life. She is a huge advocate for ongoing education, having completed Dog Handler Academy certification and Dog Facility conferences in the States. In her spare time she enjoys going for walks with her own dogs Sam (4 year old Golden cross) and Cooper (8 year old Shepherd cross), plus doing art, camping, kayaking and taking out the quad.
